integrity: All critical conclusions are analytical; a standard-library exact-rational verification program accompanies the argument. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an exogenous focal-experienced finite-support group-size law, independent partner sampling, binary actions, threshold two, and constant additive volunteering cost.
Constructive witness group sizes grow exponentially with the support index; no typicality claim is made.
No stochastic finite-population or spatial-network extension is established.
Novelty comparison covers inspected material rather than certifying universal priority; some older literature full text was not obtained.
title: Sharp equilibrium multiplicity from finite-support group-size heterogeneity in two-volunteer games
